A broad spectrum of professional opportunities within the community and social services sector remains active across the Phoenix, Arizona metropolitan area, according to recent listings collected via professional recruitment platforms. The available roles span various local governments, healthcare organizations, educational institutions, and non-profit entities operating throughout Phoenix, Mesa, Tempe, Glendale, Chandler, Avondale, Surprise, and Peoria.

Overview of Available Positions and Employers

The compiled data highlights dozens of specialized positions reflecting diverse needs in social welfare, behavioral health, case management, and community outreach. Notable roles and their corresponding organizations include:

  • Street Outreach Case Manager & Outreach Specialist: Offered by organizations such as Phoenix Rescue Mission and U.S.VETS in Phoenix and Mesa.
  • Case Management and Navigators: Positions like Case Management Navigator (EMPACT La Frontera), Mobile Health Navigator (Terros Health), Community Outreach Navigator (Southwest Behavioral & Health Services), and Wellness Navigator (Community Bridges) located across Phoenix, Mesa, and Tempe.
  • State and Municipal Roles: Openings such as Community and Housing Services Director with the City of Mesa, Congregate Care Reduction Specialist with the Arizona Department of Child Safety, and Case Manager 2 with the Arizona Department of Economic Security.
  • School Social Workers and Educators: Roles posted by Ombudsman Educational Services (Glendale), Leona Group Schools (Phoenix), Littleton Elementary School District #65 (Avondale), and Scottsdale Unified School District (Scottsdale).
  • Specialized Care and Support Roles: Including Behavioral Health Home Visitors (Southwest Human Development), Ryan White Case Managers (Prisma Community Care), HUD-VASH Social Workers (U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs), and Indigenous Wellness Community Health Workers (NATIVE HEALTH).

Practical Implications and Reader Verification

For professionals tracking the local job market in Maricopa County, these listings demonstrate ongoing recruitment across public, private, and non-profit human services sectors. Candidates interested in these fields must carefully evaluate individual listings, as requirements and application procedures vary significantly by employer.

  • Employer: Varies by specific listing (e.g., City of Mesa, Phoenix Rescue Mission, U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, Arizona Department of Child Safety).
  • Role: Multiple distinct titles spanning case management, social work, outreach, behavioral health, and coordination.
  • Location: Phoenix, Mesa, Tempe, Glendale, Chandler, Avondale, Surprise, Peoria, and surrounding Maricopa County areas.
  • Eligibility: Not specified in the source data; applicants must review individual employer pages for credentialing, education, and licensure prerequisites.
